event.title: Protesters Disrupt Microsoft Data Centre Construction in Amsterdam
event.canonical_title: Protesters Disrupt Microsoft Data Centre Construction in Amsterdam
event.summary: On November 6, over 100 activists stormed a construction site for a Microsoft data centre in Amsterdam. The protesters climbed cranes and displayed banners criticizing artificial intelligence and the company's alleged role in the conflict in Gaza.

timeline.title: Protesters Disrupt Microsoft Data Centre Construction in Amsterdam
timeline.summary: On November 6, protesters stormed a construction site in Amsterdam intended for a Microsoft data centre. They climbed cranes and displayed banners criticizing artificial intelligence and the company's alleged role in the ongoing conflict in Gaza.
key_facts: Protesters broke into a construction site for a Microsoft data centre
Protesters climbed cranes and unfurled banners
Demonstrations were against artificial intelligence and Microsoft's involvement in the Gaza conflict
